endorsements.name: Ivan Kuzymchak
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-4698
endorsements.description: The ProfilePress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via several form fields in versions up to, and including, 4.5.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level permissions and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This only affects multi-site installations and installations where unfiltered_html has been disabled.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 5.5)

endorsements.name: Ivan Kuzymchak
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-0555
endorsements.description: The Quick Restaurant Menu plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass due to a missing capability check on its AJAX actions in versions up to, and including, 2.0.2. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level permissions and above, to invoke those actions intended for administrator use. Actions include menu item creation, update and deletion and other menu management functions. Since the plugin does not verify that a post ID passed to one of its AJAX actions belongs to a menu item, this can lead to arbitrary post deletion/alteration.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.1)

povs.explanation: A published CVE record provides public, independently verifiable recognition of the credited vulnerability disclosure.
